events.title: US Treasury emergency bond buyback doubling - Bessent taps ~1T TGA
events.summary: Treasury Secretary Bessent announced doubling of long-dated bond buybacks from 2B to 4B per operation. Yields rebounded despite intervention. Considering tapping near 1T Treasury General Account. 30Y yield at 5.248%.

events.title: US-Israel war on Iran ongoing, Hormuz disruptions, oil elevated ~90
events.source: AP, Reuters, Al Jazeera, NPR, EIA
events.summary: US-Israel launched war on Iran. Iran vows seismic response to sanctions. Strait of Hormuz disruptions persist. Iran warned Gulf states against hosting US forces. Brent ~88-90, EIA forecasts elevated prices until flows normalize.

events.title: Ebola epidemic (Bundibugyo virus) in DRC - WHO PHEIC, 5290 cases, 2516 deaths
events.summary: Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. Bundibugyo ebolavirus complicates response. Africa CDC estimates only 30-40% of infections detected. WHO declared PHEIC.

events.title: 5th US bank failure of 2026 - Tioga-Franklin Savings Bank, worst since 2017
events.summary: Tioga-Franklin Savings Bank (68M assets) failed Aug 22, 5th failure of 2026, costing DIF 5.5M. Systemic risk contained but small-bank stress accelerating.

events.title: US-Japan joint yen intervention - first in a generation, yen at ~159
events.summary: US joined Japan in yen-buying operation for first time in a generation. Yen strengthened from 164 to 155 but surrendered gains, back to ~159. BOJ expected to hike rates next month.

events.title: UK gilt crisis - BOE urged to halt bond sales, 10Y at 5.05%, 30Y at 5.7%
events.summary: BOE urged to halt active gilt sales amid global bond rout. 10Y borrowing costs ~5.05%, 30Y ~5.7%. QT adding pressure to elevated yields, costing Treasury billions.
